# Anne Shirley & Uncle Jim

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) — close friend who enjoys his stories · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P9](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P59](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0059), +7 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), Mrs. Doctor Dave, and Captain Jim welcome [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to their new home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). The group enjoys supper together while Captain Jim and [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md) share stories and details about the surrounding community and neighbors.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P7](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P16](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P31](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0031)_

> Captain Jim tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md) the romantic history of the schoolmaster [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md) and his bride [Persis Leigh](../character/persis-leigh.md), who lived in their house sixty years ago. He recounts Selwyn's prophetic vision of his bride's arrival after her ship was months overdue. Before taking his leave, Captain Jim welcomes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into the select group of 'kindred spirits' who belong to 'the race that knows [Joseph](../character/joseph.md).'
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P34](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P59](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0059)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Captain Jim bond over [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) Bryant's concept of 'the race that knows Joseph', or kindred spirits. As their visitors depart into the moonlit night, Captain Jim shares stories about trimming Miss Elizabeth's Lombardies and his lifelong love of the moon. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) stroll through their garden, taking in the peaceful surroundings of their new home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P56](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0056), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P60](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0060), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P64](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0064)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walk down to the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse to visit Captain Jim. Along the way, they pass the unusually hairy [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md), and upon arriving, Captain Jim warmly welcomes them, shows them the lighthouse, and entertains them with local stories and tea.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P7](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P19](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P23](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0023)_

> Captain Jim tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) about how he saved the First Mate and shares stories from his adventurous past while showing them his collection of curiosities. After Captain Jim expresses his longing for the sea and misses his late friend [Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) promise to visit often before walking home and discussing his character.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P42](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0042), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P46](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0046), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P51](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0051), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P57](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0057)_

> On a foggy evening while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is away, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) Moore's house for company. Looking in, she sees [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) weeping bitterly in secret and decides not to disturb her, retreating outside where she meets Captain Jim bringing [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md) home. Captain Jim then walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to her house while they discuss [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) and [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P0](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P5](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P6](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P19](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0019)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) spend autumn evenings visiting Captain Jim at the lighthouse. Walking home together afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) discuss Leslie's wasted potential before affectionately reaffirming their own love and home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P2](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P4](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P7](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P13](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0013)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), welcoming guests including [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), Captain Jim, and Miss Cornelia. While dinner is prepared and served, Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia engage in a lively debate to Gilbert's amusement. After a successful meal carved by [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), the party gathers by the hearth as Captain Jim shares stories before taking his leave.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P4](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P5](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P7](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P53](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0053)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) head to [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) to watch the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) come in at the lighthouse with Captain Jim and [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md). After Captain Jim shares stories about his sleeping nephew Joe and plays his fiddle, Marshall and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) dance around the fire. At midnight, Captain Jim opens the door to welcome the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) and wishes everyone well.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P3](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P21](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0021)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her lingering sense of a barrier and quiet resentment between herself and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) with Captain Jim. Later, when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares news of her expected child, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) acts bitterly at first but eventually gives her a exquisitely handcrafted white baby dress. Inspired after reading Captain Jim's personal life-book, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wishes someone with the right literary gift could write his life story.
>

> Captain Jim visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bring her quahog shells for her garden and sweet-grass, sharing memories and thoughts on nature. Later, Captain Jim, Miss Cornelia, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Susan](../character/susan.md) gather at the house to discuss local news, religion, and neighbors, which ends in Captain Jim and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) stepping outside to laugh at the women's commentary.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P6](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P15](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P21](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P57](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0057)_

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a drive to [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) and leaves her with Captain Jim. Captain Jim comforts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her grief over losing her baby by telling her the story of his lost love, [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), and asking [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to keep her memory alive.
>

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) insists that [Susan](../character/susan.md) remain as household help so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can rest. Later, Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia visit, chatting over pie about neighborhood news, including [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) agreeing to take in a summer boarder named [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P0](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P2](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P11](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P24](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0024)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) visit Captain Jim at [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point), where Captain Jim realizes Owen is the grandson of the schoolmaster's bride from his past. Captain Jim entertains his guests with numerous sea tales and lends Owen his treasured life-book to read. On the walk home, Owen marvels at the captain's extraordinary life while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) assures him the stories are true.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P10](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P21](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P30](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P37](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0037)_

> [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) eagerly agrees to turn Captain Jim's life-book into a novel, incorporating the story of lost [Margaret](../character/margaret.md). Throughout a wonderful summer at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor), Owen works on the manuscript with input from Captain Jim, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), forming close bonds with the group before completing his draft.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P0](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P3](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P11](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P18](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0018)_

> Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to chat about newspaper obituaries, past town memories, and Leslie's feelings for [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), joined briefly by [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Later, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) grieves over the death of her old dog [Carlo](../character/carlo.md) to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After returning from a New Year's visit to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are welcomed home by Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia, who shares news about Owen Ford's book.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P0](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P12](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P26](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P30](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0030)_

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) consult Captain Jim, who surprisingly agrees that [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) must be informed about the medical possibility for [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tells [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), who decides to take [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for the operation despite the emotional toll. Later, Miss Cornelia angrily confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over the decision, but eventually accepts that nothing can stop the plan.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P4](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P22](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P30](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P48](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0048)_

> [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) prepares for Dick's surgery in [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) with Gilbert's assistance, securing financial help through a mortgage from Captain Jim. Later, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) returns home to find [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in shock over a letter from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). The letter reveals that the man believed to be [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md) is actually his lookalike cousin, [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), and that [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) died years ago.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P16](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives birth to a healthy baby boy, whom she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) name James Matthew after Captain Jim and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), Captain Jim, and Miss Cornelia visit to admire the child and celebrate his arrival. Later, Miss Cornelia tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) plans to return for a visit, and they discuss Leslie's future plans.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR

> In the wake of the general election, Captain Jim visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) to share news of the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) victory. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits the lighthouse, where she encounters a newly clean-shaven [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md). She then spends quiet moments with Captain Jim, who reflects on aging and his mortality, making [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promise to care for his cat, [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md).
>

> [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) declares his love for [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) in the garden, and she eagerly confesses her love in return. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Captain Jim join them by the fire, where Captain Jim gives them a heartwarming benediction before taking his final leave from their house. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) welcomes [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) to stay with them, and [Susan](../character/susan.md) returns from the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) with news and commentary.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P15](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P35](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0035)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) deliver the long-awaited printed copy of his life story to Captain Jim, who hosts them for tea and celebrates the occasion. The next morning, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) notices that the lighthouse light is still burning past sunrise and goes with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to investigate. They discover Captain Jim lying peacefully on his sofa, having passed away overnight while reading the final pages of his book.
>
